_about.what: Ofgem's weekly forward-delivery price for the default tariff cap's reference contracts, with each trade week given the start of the 12-month delivery period its basket covers. A bitemporal series at the resolution of a delivery START: the as-of axis is the trade week, the delivery axis is the 12 months from delivery_start. It is not a full curve: the quarter-by-quarter split inside the 12 months is not published.
_about.prices_from: sim/data/ofgem_forward_weekly_{electricity,gas}.csv (docs/data-sources/ofgem-forward-weekly.md); gas is published in pence per therm; price_gbp_per_mwh for gas is that times 10/29.3071 (29.3071 kWh per therm)
_about.rule: Ofgem, Price cap - Final guidance on treatment of price indexation in future default tariff cap periods (August 2022), footnote 6: an X-Y-Z [A] index observes 12-month forward prices over an observation window ending Y months before the cap period starts; the basket is the 12 months from that cap start. Derivation and window table: docs/market_research/the_published_forward_gets_its_delivery_axis_from_the_cap_indexation_rule_2026-10-10.md
_about.assignment: a trade week (Monday to Friday) is assigned only if it lies wholly inside one observation window
_about.point_in_time: a row may be read from its trade_week_end onward, never before: a backtest that hedges at a row before that date hedges on a price that was not yet published
_about.not_this: the price is a volume-weighted broker average for baseload quarterly contracts, not a settlement price, and carries no demand shape; a hedge cost against it needs a demand shape applied
_about.uncovered: 2016-01 to 2021-01: no free dated forward source found

windows.1: guidance table: 01/02/2022-01/06/2022 'Winter 2022' and 06/06/2022-18/08/2022 'Q4 2022', both delivering from 1 Oct 2022
windows.5: 3-1.5-12 [3], the formula; window end taken as 44 days before the cap starts (+-4 days against the table)

_about.delivery_period: 12 months from delivery_start; window names the source of the row's observation window
_about.unassigned: unassigned_reason 'boundary': an observation-window boundary falls inside the trade week; window ends are known to +-4 days, so the week is left unassigned rather than guessed
